name: exo
description: Claude Code plugin with four stages and hooks that refuse risky commands.

specs.title: Where spec stores specs
specs.description: docs: files under docs/specs. issues: GitHub issues. both: a file plus a linked issue. Not sure? Keep docs. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

compression.title: How compact replies are
compression.description: low: short plain text, no preamble, recap or filler; code, paths, errors and warnings stay whole. off: full prose. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

budget.title: Agent model budget
budget.description: off: no exo dispatch sets a model or effort, so every agent inherits the session. fast, balanced, quality: a hook sets each dispatch's model and effort from the column of that name in the kind table in lib/model-kinds.json. Not sure? Keep off. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

ship.title: How ship finishes a run
ship.description: ask: ship puts the question. pr-merge: open a pull request and merge it once checks pass. open-pr: open a pull request and stop. push: push the branch. local: keep the commits on this machine. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

workspace.title: Where a code-changing run commits
workspace.description: ask: the run puts the question. branch: a new branch in this checkout. worktree: a new git worktree. current: the branch already checked out. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

guards.title: Safety guards
guards.description: on: the safety guards refuse the commands and edits they cover. off: no guard refuses anything. Not sure? Keep on. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

env.title: Local env files in a run
env.description: ask: the run puts the question. copy: copy the local env files into the run's worktree. never: copy none. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.
